messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage A:
"""
Any premiums or deposit received towards the product that is withdrawn, but where no policy has been issued, shall be refunded to the policyholders immediately. Such monies shall not be adjusted for issuance of any other policies except with specific consent of the policyholder and the consent of the policyholder shall be recorded in written or digital mode. 9. Insurers shall also put in place measures for immediate withdrawal of sales literature, prospectus and publicity material that is issued in respect of the product withdrawn. Chapter III: Miscellaneous Provisions I. Model Product for Persons with Disabilities (PWD), Persons afflicted with HIV/AIDS, and those with Mental Illness: 1. All general and health Insurers shall offer a specific cover for Persons with Disabilities (PWD), persons affected with HIV/AIDS, and those with mental illness in compliance with the following provisions; I.
"""

Passage B:
"""
Chapter III Miscellaneous Provisions: I. Model Product for Persons with Disabilities, Persons afflicted with HIV/AIDS and those with Mental Illness II. Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) number III. Submission of Returns IV. Repeal of Guidelines and Circulars 17 17 17 17 Effective date: (1) This Master circular shall come into force with immediate effect except for provisions where specific effective date is mentioned. (2) The existing products which are not complying with the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024 and this Master Circular shall be modified on or before 30.09.2024. Revision in terms and conditions of the products that are warranted exclusively due to the application of any of the updated provisions contained in this circular or the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations,2024 shall be carried out under the extant UIN, with the approval of Product Management Committee(PMC).
"""

Write ONE question whose full answer needs a fact from Passage A AND a fact from Passage B (e.g. combine two rules, or apply one rule to the situation in the other). If no natural question needs both, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts_a": [1-3 word-for-word spans from A], "facts_b": [1-3 word-for-word spans from B], "sub_queries": [a short search query for A's fact, a short search query for B's fact]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"If a policyholder wants to withdraw a product that hasn't been issued yet, will they receive an immediate refund and does the insurer need to modify the product by 30.09.2024?","answer":"Yes, the policyholder will receive an immediate refund of any premiums or deposit paid for the withdrawn product, and the insurer must modify the product to comply with the regulations by 30.09.2024.","facts_a":["Any premiums or deposit received towards the product that is withdrawn, but where no policy has been issued, shall be refunded to the policyholders immediately"],"facts_b":["The existing products which are not complying with the IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations 2024 and this Master Circular shall be modified on or before 30.09.2024"],"sub_queries":["premiums or deposit refunded immediately for withdrawn product","modify product by 30.09.2024"]}]}
